headline: Kai, Iran answered the Larak strike at dawn — ballistic missiles at two U.S. bases in Jordan, eight intercepted, and futures barely flinched.
subline: WTI is back near $85, September hike odds went into the weekend at 57%, and Friday's jobs report is still the week's main event.
asof: Pre-market · index futures as of ~6:45 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Futures drift lower; oil firms again
items.sentence: Trading Economics quotes S&P futures down 0.25% and Nasdaq 100 futures down 0.70% early Monday, with WTI up 1.63% at $84.76, gold easing to $4,436.85, and the 10-year steady near 4.72%.

items.title: Hormuz transits: 24 ships last week
items.sentence: OPB's wire report says commercial passages through the strait fell to 24 vessels last week from roughly 130 a day before the February war, after U.S. forces destroyed IRGC launchers being readied to mine the waterway.

items.title: Bitcoin steady above $78,000
items.sentence: CoinDesk quotes bitcoin at $78,512 early Monday, up 0.47% over 24 hours — holding its ground through a weekend that brought U.S. and Iranian strikes.

items.title: Payrolls Friday is the week's last word
items.sentence: Newsquawk's calendar shows a quiet U.S. Monday, ISM manufacturing and JOLTS Tuesday, ADP Wednesday, then the August jobs report Friday — the last big print before the Fed's mid-September meeting.

items.title: PayPal −12% after $50 billion bid dies
items.sentence: Yahoo Finance's Friday wrap logged PayPal down 12% after Stripe and Advent abandoned their $50 billion takeover approach.

items.title: Iran fires ballistic missiles at bases in Jordan
items.sentence: RFE/RL reports the IRGC struck at the King Hussein and Al Azraq bases at dawn after Sunday's U.S. strike on Larak Island launchers, while Jordan's military says it intercepted eight missiles.

items.title: G20 finance chiefs meet in Asheville
items.sentence: Euronews reports Iran sanctions and tariffs will shadow the talks opening in North Carolina today.

items.title: Italy extends Spain border checks 15 days
items.sentence: Euronews reports Rome kept its Schengen suspension with Spain in place for another fifteen days over the Ceuta tensions.

items.title: Shein prices Hong Kong IPO at $26 billion
items.sentence: Fortune reports the retailer raised $1.7 billion at a $26 billion valuation — down from $100 billion in 2022 — on $41.9 billion of 2025 revenue.

items.title: Taiwan raids Nvidia board supplier Unimicron
items.sentence: Focus Taiwan reports Taoyuan prosecutors searched the PCB maker and questioned 14 people over China-made boards allegedly relabeled as Taiwan-origin, releasing one general manager on NT$15 million bail.

items.title: EU puts ChatGPT under strictest platform rules
items.sentence: Euronews reports ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox now fall under the bloc's most stringent digital-safety obligations.

items.title: SB Energy hands OpenAI $5.5 billion sweetener
items.sentence: Seeking Alpha, citing the WSJ, says SB Energy issued OpenAI $5.5 billion in warrants to anchor the Ports-Pike data-center campus in Ohio.

items.title: Flock cameras draw Hawley probe, city cancellations
items.sentence: Fortune reports Senator Hawley opened an investigation and more than 90 cities have moved to cancel or reject contracts for the 120,000-camera license-plate network.
